title: Survival Signals
coreMove: Cluster small signals in context before deciding whether the pattern deserves action.
sourcePressure: Survival signals are early warning cues whose meaning comes from clustering and context, not from a single odd detail isolated from the scene.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating every odd cue as proof of danger.
sourceAnchorNote: Frozen notes contain no traceable named anecdote, study, place, date, or artifact for this chapter; use fictional protagonists only and keep claims tied to the listed source pressure.

hook: opening with a generic alarm-bell sentence for ch04
starting with a definition of fear, intuition, danger, or prediction
counterintuition: the safe move is not always the polite move
trust your gut instead of overthinking
tryThisNow: set a timer and list your boundaries
examples: generic office hallway pressure with no access detail
late-night parking lot with only atmosphere and no behavior pattern
reused date or elevator shell without chapter-specific beat

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside only if source-supported, a direct second-person passage, or a brief source-anchor reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
